buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to

minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address 2nd Floor Central Revenue Building GST & Central Excise Commissionerate Bhubaneswar Odisha . 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Mandatory Requirements for Bidders A bid shall be liable for disqualification if any of the following mandatory requirements is not fulfill ed: 1. Availability of Office of the Service Provider : An office of the Service Provider must be located within the District of the Consignee. Documen tary evidence in support of the same shall be uploaded along with the bid. 2. Submission of Mandatory Documents and Past Performance The bidder's offer shall be liable for rejection if any of the certificates/documents specifically sought in the Bid/Tender Document are not uploaded/submitted. The bid may also be rejected if the bidder's past experience/performance with the Department has been found to be unsatisfactory. 3. Stamping and Signing of Documents Every page of the bid/tender document and all supporting documents shall be duly signed and s tamped by the authorized signatory of the bidder. 4. Scope of Work The scope of work includes the prepare of aluminium partition, as specified in the tender docu ment. 5. Mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting Attendance at the pre-bid meeting is mandatory. Documentary evidence of participation/atten dance in the pre-bid meeting shall be uploaded along with the bid. Failure to attend the mandatory pre-bid meeting and/or failure to upload the required supporting document may render the bid liab le for rejection. 6. Compliance with Tender Terms and Specifications Any non-compliance with the terms and conditions of the tender, non-uploading of required docu ments, lack of clarity in specifications, contradictions/inconsistencies in the bid, or failure to provid e the required supporting literature/documents may lead to rejection of the bid. 7. Right of the Department · Right to reject or terminate: The GST & Central Excise Commissionerate, Bhubaneswar can reject a bid or disqualify/terminate a bidder at any stage before the contract is finalized , without giving a reason. · Termination during the contract: Even after the contract begins, the Commissionerate can terminate the contract during its validity period without assigning a reason.

· No compensation: If the bid or contract is rejected/terminated under this provision, the b idder/tenderer cannot claim compensation or damages merely because of that action. · Relaxation of conditions: The Commissionerate can relax any of the tender conditions if it considers such relaxation appropriate. · Disputes: If a dispute arises, the clause states that the decision of the Commissionerate will be final and binding on the bidder/tenderer. Non-Blacklisting Declaration The Service Provider/Bidder must not have been blacklisted/debarred by any organization or Gove rnment Department as on the date of submission of the Bid/Tender. A suitable self- declaration/undertaking to this effect shall be submitted along with the bid. .
